steps.title: When I POST /carts
Then the response status is 201 with the cart's id
And reading the cart lists no products

specs.title: SCN-002.1: Adding a product with quantity 1

steps.title: Given an empty cart and an in-stock product
[SEED] find an in-stock product (GET /products/search)
[SEED] empty cart (POST /carts)
When I add the product with quantity 1
Then the response status is 200
And the cart lists the product with quantity 1

specs.title: SCN-002.2: Adding a product with quantity 99

steps.title: Given an empty cart and an in-stock product
[SEED] find an in-stock product (GET /products/search)
[SEED] empty cart (POST /carts)
When I add the product with quantity 99
Then the response status is 200
And the cart lists the product with quantity 99

specs.title: SCN-003: Adding a product already in the cart increases its quantity

steps.title: Given a cart holding an in-stock product with quantity 2
[SEED] find an in-stock product (GET /products/search)
[SEED] empty cart (POST /carts)
[SEED] add the product with quantity 2
When I add the same product with quantity 3
Then the cart lists the product once with quantity 5

specs.title: SCN-004.1: A quantity of 0 is rejected

steps.title: Given a cart holding an in-stock product with quantity 1
[SEED] empty cart (POST /carts)
[SEED] add the product with quantity 1
When I add the product with quantity 0
Then the response status is 422 with an error for the quantity field
And the cart is unchanged

specs.title: SCN-004.2: A quantity of 100 is rejected

steps.title: Given a cart holding an in-stock product with quantity 1
[SEED] empty cart (POST /carts)
[SEED] add the product with quantity 1
When I add the product with quantity 100
Then the response status is 422 with an error for the quantity field
And the cart is unchanged

specs.title: SCN-005: Adding to the cart from a product page

steps.title: Given I am on the product page of an in-stock product
When I choose quantity 2 and press "Add to cart"
Then I see "Product added to shopping cart."
And the cart icon shows 2

specs.title: SCN-006: The cart page lists quantity, unit price, line total and cart total

steps.title: Given I added an in-stock product with quantity 3 on its product page
When I open the cart page
Then the product is listed with quantity 3, its unit price and line total = unit price × 3
And the cart total equals the sum of the line totals

specs.title: SCN-007: Removing a product from the cart

steps.title: Given a cart holding an in-stock product
[SEED] empty cart (POST /carts)
[SEED] add the product with quantity 1
When I DELETE the product from the cart
Then the response status is 204
And the cart no longer lists the product
